units.title: 啊、让、但
units.intro: HSK 2, words 1–40, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.p: shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài a
ex.en: How time flies!

ex.p: nǐ dāng nǐ shì shéi a
ex.en: Who do you think you are?

items.en: to yield; to permit; to let sb do sth

ex.p: bù yào ràng diàn shì jī kāi zhe
ex.en: Don't leave the TV on.

ex.p: tā ràng wǒ zuò wǒ jiù zuò le
ex.en: He told me to do it, so I did it.

items.en: but; yet; however; still; merely; only; just

ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu chē dàn wǒ jiě mèi yǒu
ex.en: I don't have a car, but my sister does.

ex.zh: 我听了，但什么也没听到。
ex.p: wǒ yǐn le dàn shén me yě méi tīng dào
ex.en: I listened, but I didn't hear anything.

ex.p: nǐ zì jǐ yīng gāi zhī dào ba
ex.en: You must know yourself.

ex.p: nǐ ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ zì jǐ
ex.en: You remind me of myself.

items.en: to obtain; to get; to gain

ex.p: tā dá wǎng qiú dá de hěn hǎo
ex.en: He plays tennis very well.

ex.p: tā páo de bǐ tā gē ge kuài
ex.en: He ran faster than his brother did.

ex.p: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ dōu kě yǐ
ex.en: You can go wherever you want.

ex.p: nǐ jīn tiān kě yǐ xiū jià yī tiān
ex.en: You can take today off.

items.en: as (in the capacity of); to take sth as; to act as

ex.p: wèi shén me wǒ hái zài zhè lǐ
ex.en: Why am I still here?

ex.p: wèi shén me xiàn zài zuò nà gè
ex.en: Why do that now?

ex.p: tā yǐ jīng chī guò wǔ fàn le
ex.en: He has already had lunch.

ex.p: tā yǐ jīng shì gè nán rén le
ex.en: He's already a man.

items.en: this kind of; so; this way

ex.p: dà jiā dōu shì zhè yàng xiǎng de
ex.en: Everybody thinks so.

ex.p: nǐ tīng shuō guò zhè yàng de shì ma
ex.en: Have you ever heard of such a thing?

items.en: if; in case; in the event that

ex.p: nà rú guǒ nà shì zhēn de ne
ex.en: So what if that's true?

ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ huì chàng gē jiù hǎo le
ex.en: If you can sing, that's good enough.

items.en: because; owing to; on account of

ex.p: tā bù zài shì yīn wèi bìng le
ex.en: She's absent because she's sick.

ex.zh: 他不在这儿，因为他病了。
ex.p: tā bù zài zhèr yīn wèi tā bìng le
ex.en: He isn't here because he's ill.

ex.p: nǐ yòu lái le
ex.en: There you go again.

ex.p: yòu xià yǔ le
ex.en: It's raining again!

ex.p: bù zhǐ shì qián guān xi zhòng dà
ex.en: Money isn't the only thing that matters.

ex.p: wǒ men zhǐ yǒu yī cì jī huì
ex.en: We have only one chance.

ex.p: nǐ zhī dào wèn tí zài nǎ lǐ
ex.en: You know where the problem lies.

ex.p: wǒ men jiù shì wèn tí suǒ zài
ex.en: We're the problem.

ex.p: gào sù wǒ ná tā zuò shén me
ex.en: Tell me what to do with it.

ex.p: tā men zhōng méi yǒu wǒ yào de
ex.en: I don't want either of them.

ex.p: dàn shì wǒ bù yào
ex.en: But I don't want to.

ex.p: tā bù zhī dào gāi gàn shén me
ex.en: He doesn't know what to do.

ex.p: tā zhè gè shí hou gāi dào le
ex.en: This is the time he normally arrives.

items.en: to change or replace; to experience; watch (e.g. of a sentry or guard)

ex.p: nǐ běn yīng gāi lái de gēng zǎo de
ex.en: You should have come earlier.

ex.p: yǒu xiē shì bù zuò gēng hǎo
ex.en: Some things are better left undone.

ex.p: tā men kě néng yǒu diǎn shén me
ex.en: Maybe they have something.

ex.p: tā kě néng hěn kuài jiù dào le
ex.en: He is likely to arrive soon.

items.en: ability; talent; sb of a certain type; a capable individual

ex.p: tā ér zi shì gè tiān cái
ex.en: Her son is a genius.

ex.p: wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng zhǎo dào tā
ex.en: How do we find it?

items.en: to resemble; to be like; to look as if

ex.p: jīn tiān tiān qì hǎo xiàng bù cuò
ex.en: The weather looks good today.

ex.p: tā men dōu xiàng zhè yī yàng ma
ex.en: Are they all like this?

ex.p: tā dāng shí yī gè rén zài jiā
ex.en: He was home alone at the time.

ex.p: nǐ yǐ hòu xiǎng dāng shén me ne
ex.en: What would you like to be in the future?

ex.p: suǒ yǐ nǎ lǐ yǒu wèn tí
ex.en: So where's the problem?

ex.zh: 我今天累，所以我睡得早。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān lěi suǒ yǐ wǒ shuì de zǎo
ex.en: I was tired today so I went to bed early.

items.en: like that; in that way; or so

ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me nà me gāo xìng
ex.en: Why are you so happy?

ex.p: wǒ méi xiǎng dào tā yǒu nà me dà
ex.en: I did not expect it to be that big.

ex.p: dài wǒ xiàng nǐ jiā rén wèn hǎo
ex.en: Please say hello to your family.

ex.p: ràng tā men xiàng wǒ men xué xí
ex.en: Let them learn from us.

items.en: so much; this much; how much?

ex.p: wǒ cháng duì zì jǐ zhè me shuō
ex.en: I often say that to myself.

ex.p: shì wǒ yě shì zhè me xiǎng de
ex.en: Yeah. I think so, too.

items.en: to believe; to think; to consider; to feel

ex.p: tā rèn wéi wǒ fēi cháng de lěi
ex.en: He thought that I was very tired.

ex.p: wǒ bù rèn wéi shì nǐ zuò de
ex.en: I don't think you did this.

ex.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài xué xí ma
ex.en: Shouldn't you be studying?

ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi xiàn zài jiù huí jiā
ex.en: You should go home now.

ex.p: wǒ gěi nǐ dài le diǎn dōng xī
ex.en: I brought you a little something.

ex.p: tā jīn tiān dài le wǔ fàn
ex.en: He brought his lunch today.

ex.p: tā shì wǒ de yī wèi lǎo péng you
ex.en: He is my old friend.

ex.p: tā shuō huà jiù xiàng yī wèi lǎo shī
ex.en: He talks as if he were a teacher.

ex.p: dà jiā dōu xiǎng zuò zài tā páng biān
ex.en: Everybody wants to sit beside her.

ex.p: dà jiā xiào le
ex.en: Everybody laughed.

items.en: to notice; to become aware of; to discover; to find; to detect; a discovery

ex.p: nǐ hái fā xiàn shén me le
ex.en: What else have you figured out?

ex.p: wǒ fā xiàn dòu zhè běn shū hěn nán
ex.en: I found it difficult to read the book.

ex.p: nǐ yī dìng shì kāi wán xiào
ex.en: You must be joking!

ex.p: tā yī dìng shì shēng bìng le
ex.en: She must be sick.

ex.p: tā yī gè rén shēng huó
ex.en: He lives alone.

ex.zh: 我们在一起生活了三年。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yī qǐ shēng huó le sān nián
ex.en: We lived together for three years.

items.en: straight (in a straight line); continuously; always; all the way through

ex.p: wǒ zhī dào tā yī zhí hěn máng
ex.en: I know that she has been busy.

ex.p: jīn tiān wǒ yī zhí hěn máng
ex.en: I've had a busy day.

ex.p: tā bù guò shì gè hái zi
ex.en: He is but a child.

ex.p: zhè jiā gōng sī de lǎo bǎn shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the boss of this company?

ex.zh: 不要自己一个人走回家。
ex.p: bù yào zì jǐ yī gè rén zǒu huí jiā
ex.en: Don't walk home alone.

ex.p: bù yào cuò guò gōng chē
ex.en: Don't miss the bus.

ex.p: nǐ ér zi xiàn zài chéng rén le
ex.en: Your son has come of age.

ex.p: wǒ men yǐ shì chéng nián rén le
ex.en: We're adults.

items.en: name; noun (part of speech); place (e.g. among winners)

ex.p: wǒ zhǐ zhī dào tā de míng zi
ex.en: I only know him by name.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào tā de míng zi
ex.en: I would like to know her name.

units.title: 所有、而且、必须
units.intro: HSK 2, words 41–80, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: all; to have; to possess; to own

ex.p: suǒ yǒu rén dōu shì huó zhe de
ex.en: Everybody is alive.

ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu wài xīng rén dōu huài
ex.en: Not all aliens are bad.

items.en: (not only ...) but also; moreover; in addition

ex.zh: 我结婚了，而且有两个孩子。
ex.p: wǒ jié hūn le ér qiě yǒu liǎng gè hái zi
ex.en: I am married and have two children.

ex.p: wǒ men bì xū qù xué xiào le
ex.en: We must go to school.

ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài bì xū qù kāi huì
ex.en: I have to go to a meeting now.

ex.p: tā shì zuì nián cháng de ér zi
ex.en: He's the oldest son.

ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me cháng bù dà ne
ex.en: Why don't you grow up?

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi rì yǔ lǎo shī
ex.en: I want to become a teacher of Japanese.

ex.p: nǐ zhǎng dà hòu xiǎng chéng wéi shén me
ex.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?

items.en: other; (sth or sb) else; the rest

ex.zh: 我们要去其他的什么地方？
ex.p: wǒ men yào qù qí tā de shén me dì fāng
ex.en: Where else should we go?

ex.zh: 我有问题，就像其他人一样。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu wèn tí jiù xiàng qí tā rén yī yàng
ex.en: I have problems, just like everybody else.

ex.p: ān quán shì zuì zhòng yào de shì qing
ex.en: Safety is what matters most.

ex.p: yǒu jiàn shì qing wǒ yào duì nǐ shuō
ex.en: There's something I want to tell you.

items.en: feeling; impression; sensation; to feel; to perceive

ex.p: nǐ gǎn jué zěn me yàng tā wèn
ex.en: "How do you feel?" he asked.

ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān gǎn jué hǎo duō le
ex.en: I feel much better today.

ex.p: wǒ men xiān chī fàn rán hòu zài zǒu
ex.en: First we'll eat, and then we'll go.

ex.p: nǐ chī miàn tiáo hái shi chī fàn
ex.en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice?

ex.zh: 我不想在这些条件下工作。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài zhè xiē tiáo jiàn xià gōng zuò
ex.en: I don't want to work under these conditions.

ex.p: wǒ men zài jī chǎng wèi tā sòng xíng
ex.en: We saw her off at the airport.

ex.p: wǒ huì kāi chē sòng nǐ qù jī chǎng
ex.en: I'll drive you to the airport.

items.en: item; component; classifier for events, things, clothes etc

ex.p: nǐ bù zhī dào nà jiàn shì ma
ex.en: Don't you know that?

ex.p: nín zuì hǎo chuān yī jiàn yǔ yī
ex.en: You'd better put on a raincoat.

ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn xíng cè shì
ex.en: We should run some tests.

ex.p: wèi shén me tā shì bì yào de
ex.en: Why should it be necessary?

ex.p: tā yǐ wéi shén me dōu zhī dào
ex.en: He thinks he knows everything.

ex.zh: 你想出去喝几杯或吃个饭吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng chū qù hē jī bēi huò chī gè fàn ma
ex.en: Would you like to go for a drink or something to eat?

ex.p: nǐ zǒu huò liú suí nǐ gāo xìng
ex.en: You can go or stay, as you wish.

items.en: to appear; to arise; to emerge

ex.p: guó wáng míng wǎn huì qīn zì chū xiàn
ex.en: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.

ex.p: tā bǐ wǒ gāo yī gè tóu
ex.en: He is a head taller than me.

ex.p: wǒ men shuì guò tóu le
ex.en: We overslept.

ex.p: wǒ míng tiān néng jiàn dào nǐ ma
ex.en: Will I see you tomorrow?

ex.p: wǒ shàng zhōu jiàn dào le tā
ex.en: I saw him last week.

items.en: to pass through; to get through; to adopt (a resolution); to pass (legislation)

ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bù tōng guò kǎo shì
ex.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

ex.p: wǒ bì xū tōng guò zhè cháng kǎo shì
ex.en: I have to pass this exam.

ex.p: shàng zhōu yī wǒ méi qù shàng xué
ex.en: I didn't go to school last Monday.

ex.p: shàng zhōu yī wǒ méi yǒu gōng zuò
ex.en: I didn't work last Monday.

ex.p: duō shǎo nián guò qù le
ex.en: Years passed.

ex.p: zhēn xiǎng shuì guò qù a
ex.en: I want to sleep.

items.en: to participate; to take part; to join

ex.p: shéi dōu kě yǐ cān jiā
ex.en: Anyone can join.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng cān jiā
ex.en: I want to participate.

ex.p: nǐ hé wǒ zài zhè lǐ hěn ān quán
ex.en: You're safe here with me.

ex.p: nín zài yī gè ān quán de dì fāng
ex.en: You are in a safe place.

ex.p: gào sù wǒ kǎo shì jiē guǒ
ex.en: Let me know about the result of the exam.

ex.p: zhè méi yǒu jiē guǒ
ex.en: It came to nothing.

ex.p: tā zǒu lù huò zhě qí chē guò lái
ex.en: He'll come on foot or by bicycle.

ex.p: wǒ jué de tā zhēn de hěn bù cuò
ex.en: I thought it was very good.

ex.p: kàn qǐ lai bù cuò
ex.en: It looks good.

ex.p: méi rén gěi wǒ men jī huì
ex.en: Nobody gave us a chance.

ex.p: jī huì cuò guò le
ex.en: The chance is gone.

ex.p: wǒ wán quán bù yào niú nǎi
ex.en: I don't want any milk at all.

ex.p: zhè wán quán shì wǒ zì jǐ zuò de
ex.en: I did that all on my own.

items.en: to finish; to be over; whole

ex.p: nǐ de shí jiān kuài yòng wán le
ex.en: Your time is running out.

ex.p: nǐ dòu wán nà běn shū le ma
ex.en: Have you finished reading that book?

items.en: to send out; to show (one's feeling); to issue

ex.p: jīn tiān fā shēng le shén me shì
ex.en: What happened today?

ex.p: tā míng tiān chū fā qù zhōng guó
ex.en: He leaves for China tomorrow.

ex.p: jīn wǎn yǒu shén me jì huà ma
ex.en: Do you have plans tonight?

ex.p: wǒ de jì huà hé nǐ de bù tóng
ex.en: My plan is different from yours.

ex.p: tā shuō de huà quán bù kě xìn
ex.en: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.

ex.p: quán zhī shì bù kě néng de
ex.en: It isn't possible to know everything.

ex.p: nǐ fàng xué yǐ hòu gàn shén me
ex.en: What do you do after school?

ex.zh: 你以后再也不会看到它了。
ex.p: nǐ yǐ hòu zài yě bù huì kàn dào tā le
ex.en: You'll never see that again.

ex.p: tā de yāo qiú rú xià
ex.en: His request is as follows.

ex.zh: 你的行为离要求的太远了。
ex.p: nǐ de xíng wéi chī yāo qiú de tài yuǎn le
ex.en: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.

ex.p: bù yào xiāng xìn tā shuō de huà
ex.en: Don't believe what he says.

ex.p: tā duì zì jǐ hěn yǒu zì xìn
ex.en: He has great confidence in himself.

ex.p: wǒ men yào nǐ zuò duì zhǎng
ex.en: We want you to be the team captain.

ex.p: wǒ men duì jìn le dì yī gè qiú
ex.en: Our team scored the first goal.

items.en: to receive; to answer (the phone); to meet or welcome sb

ex.p: wǒ hé wǒ bà ba wán jiē qiú
ex.en: I played catch with my father.

ex.p: wǒ míng zǎo bā diǎn lái jiē nǐ
ex.en: I'll call for you at eight tomorrow morning.

items.en: to be convinced (that sth is true); to believe; to accept sth as true

ex.p: wǒ zài yě bù xiāng xìn tā le
ex.en: I do not trust him any longer.

ex.p: wèi shén me méi yǒu rén xiāng xìn wǒ
ex.en: Why does no one believe me?

ex.p: nǐ shì bù shì gāng rèn shi tā
ex.en: Did you just get to know him?

ex.p: tā gāng hǎo zhǔn shí dào xiào
ex.en: He got to school just in time.

结.m: (of a plant) to produce (fruit or seeds)

者.m: (after a verb or adjective) one who (is) ...

相.m: as in 相信 (to be convinced (that sth is true))

items.en: although; even though (often used correlatively with 是 or 是 etc)

ex.en: He replied that he did not know.

ex.en: There was nothing I could do at that time.

items.en: to fall; to drop; to lag behind

ex.en: Don't drop this cup.

ex.p: wǒ diào le wǒ de qián bāo

items.en: to change; to alter; to transform

ex.p: tā gǎi biàn xiǎng fǎ le
ex.en: He changed his mind.

ex.p: wǒ méi gǎi biàn

items.en: to speak; to explain; to negotiate

ex.en: She was out of Japan last year.

ex.p: nǐ shén me shí hou lí kāi
ex.en: When will you leave?

ex.p: yī mò rì yuán gòu ma
ex.en: Will ten thousand yen do?

items.en: to be born; to give birth; life

ex.p: jīn tiān yě shì wǒ de shēng rì
ex.en: Today is my birthday, too.

ex.p: tā men wèi shén me zài shēng qì
ex.en: Why are they angry?

ex.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ kàn tú piàn
ex.en: I will show you the picture.

ex.p: ràng wǒ kàn kàn nà xiē zhào piàn

ex.p: tā de fāng fǎ bù kē xué
ex.en: His methods are not scientific.

items.en: direct (opposite: indirect 间接); immediate; straightforward

ex.en: He's very straightforward.

items.en: to sell; to betray; to spare no effort

ex.p: zhè shì yào mài de dōng xī ma
ex.en: Is this for sale?

ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me mài le tā

items.en: to choose; to pick; to select
